appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Additional Promotion Weeks: Ad Spend vs Sales'.
X-axis range: 25 to 75, with tick marks every 5 units.
Y-axis range: 60 to 170, with tick marks every 10 units.
Five blue circular data points, each labeled with a week number (Week 7 to Week 11).
Data points are positioned in ascending order from left to right, corresponding to increasing advertising spend.
Data points are positioned in ascending order from bottom to top, corresponding to increasing sales.
